  2. Segmented control

Segmented control

One compact choice among a few options, on a shared track with the selected segment raised.

Related terms: segmented control, toggle group, pill tabs, view switcher, button group.

.segmented is the track and each .segment a direct child. The look is shared; the semantics come from the markup, so pick the anatomy by what the choice does:

UseMarkupSelectedKeyboard
Pick a value<fieldset> of radios:checkedNative arrows
Switch panelsrole="tablist"aria-selected="true"Tabs runtime
Navigate<nav> of linksaria-current="page"Tab, Enter

Segments share the width equally and the track is at least --control-size tall, so it lines up with .btn and .input; .sm and .lg size it like any control. A long label wraps instead of truncating, and the row grows with it. A parent that stretches its children (.stack) makes it full width; add .align-self-start to keep it at its content width.

Pick a value

Wrap each radio in its label. The radio is visually hidden but stays focusable and submitted; in a browser without :has() it stays visible beside the label.

Range 
<fieldset class="segmented">
  <legend class="sr-only">Range</legend>
  <label class="segment"><input type="radio" name="range" value="day">Day</label>
  <label class="segment"><input type="radio" name="range" value="week" checked>Week</label>
  <label class="segment"><input type="radio" name="range" value="month">Month</label>
</fieldset>

Switch panels

A tablist with data-enhance="tabs" takes the tabs runtime unchanged: it reads the roles, not the classes.

List view
Grid view
<div class="segmented" role="tablist" aria-label="View" data-enhance="tabs">
  <button class="segment" type="button" role="tab" id="view-list-tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="view-list">List</button>
  <button class="segment" type="button" role="tab" id="view-grid-tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="view-grid" tabindex="-1">Grid</button>
</div>
<section role="tabpanel" id="view-list" aria-labelledby="view-list-tab">List view</section>
<section role="tabpanel" id="view-grid" aria-labelledby="view-grid-tab" hidden>Grid view</section>

Navigate

Day Week Month 
<nav class="segmented" aria-label="Period">
  <a class="segment" href="#day" aria-current="page">Day</a>
  <a class="segment" href="#week">Week</a>
  <a class="segment" href="#month">Month</a>
</nav>

When to use something else

  • Several options on at once (bold, italic): .join of .btn with aria-pressed, see joined controls.
  • More options than fit on one row: tabs, whose strip scrolls.
  • Long or descriptive options: choice cards or plain radios.

Hooks

  • --segmented-bg — track fill.
  • --segmented-pad — inset between the track and its segments, also the gap between segments; the segment radius is the track radius minus it.
  • --segmented-radius — track corner radius.
  • --segmented-fg — label ink of the unselected segments; the selected one takes --text.
  • --segmented-selected-bg — fill of the selected segment. Its shadow follows --shadow, so a flat theme removes it at the theme level.
  • --segmented-selected-border — hairline around the selected segment. It is what sets the segment apart where its fill is darker than the track; a theme whose fill is lighter can fade it.
